rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both orders delegate presidential authority to cabinet officials to prescribe allowances, use closely parallel formulations identifying the statutory authority vested in the President, involve consultation with the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, and preserve existing regulations until superseded by action under the new order. C22 is substantively closer because it contains the clothing-and-cash-allowance regime that the child transfers to departmental administration, but it is primarily the regulatory subject being displaced rather than the strongest model for the child's delegation-and-continuity drafting. C16 is a weaker general delegation analogue.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense ... and the Secretary of the Treasury ... are hereby authorized and directed ... to perform the functions vested in the President ... relative to prescribing ... clothing ... and ... the cash allowance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of State is authorized and directed to exercise the following-described statutory powers of the President ... to prescribe regulations governing the granting of ... allowances
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel operative delegation of presidential statutory power to a cabinet secretary to prescribe allowances.

shared_material.child_excerpt: after appropriate consultation with the Director of the Bureau of the Budget
shared_material.parent_excerpt: with respect to regulations prescribed by the Secretary of State such authority of the President shall be exercised by the Director of the Bureau of the Budget
shared_material.explanation: Both integrate the Budget Director into the exercise of the delegated allowance-setting authority.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Existing regulations governing the subject matters of this order ... shall ... remain in effect until modified, revoked, or superseded by action taken pursuant to this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Existing rules and regulations pertaining to the allowances and allotments referred to in this order shall remain in effect until superseded by action taken pursuant to this order.
shared_material.explanation: This is a highly similar continuity clause tied specifically to allowance regulations and later action under the delegating order.
